data.title: 优香 · 周末书店的小票
data.description: 【优香 · 周末书店的小票】周末的街角书店门外，优香穿着米色风衣、奶油色高领毛衣和藏青格裙，肩上挎着小黑包。她一手抱住刚买的两本书，另一手看着收据核对金额，确认无误后露出轻松的笑容——「书买到了，预算也正好。接下来可以慢慢逛回去。」
data.action: 站在书店门外，一手抱住两本书，另一手查看收据
data.promptProse: Outside a neighborhood bookshop, Yuuka wears her beige trench coat over a cream turtleneck and navy plaid skirt, cradling two books against one arm while checking a receipt in the other hand. Mild afternoon sunlight warms the shop window and fallen leaves along the pavement, framing her satisfied smile after a carefully budgeted purchase.
data.camera: medium shot at the bookstore entrance, books and receipt visible
data.lighting: 书店橱窗前温和的午后日光
